summary: Elizabeth Paine of Lavenham, Suffolk, who sailed to New England on the Francis in 1634 and died at Watertown; John's 11th-great-grandmother.
bio:
Elizabeth Paine, later Elizabeth Hammond, was baptized at Lavenham, Suffolk, England, on 11 September 1586. Her brother William Paine of Ipswich and Boston and her sisters Dorothy (Paine) Eire and Phebe (Paine) Page also emigrated to New England. In April 1634, aged 47, she sailed from Ipswich on the Francis with Elizabeth, aged 15, Sarah, 10, and John, 7.

She died in 1670 at Watertown, Middlesex County, Massachusetts, aged 83. An earlier historian of the Hammond family had doubted that she was the Elizabeth baptized at Lavenham, placing her instead in the parish of Nowton, but later scholarship has restored the Lavenham identification. She was John's 11th-great-grandmother.
sources: Anderson, Great Migration Begins pp. 852–3; Great Migration vol. V
